plugin.name: PixelLab
plugin.description: Create pixel art, characters, animations, tilesets and effects with your PixelLab account.
plugin.longDescription: Pixel art, characters, objects, animations, rotations, tilesets, tiles, effects, UI and pixel-art edits from PixelLab, as models in the Image node. Models that use a reference picture as the subject accept an empty description. Pictures and tiles come back as PNGs; characters, objects, rotations, animations and effects as GIFs. Paid jobs resume after a restart; stop ends local waiting, and PixelLab may still finish and charge for the job.
config.apiKey.title: PixelLab API key
model.bitforge.description: An optional reference picture sets the style.
model.imagePro.description: Up to four reference pictures guide the subject.
model.stylePro.description: One to four reference pictures set the style and size.
model.imageProFlash.description: 128×128. An optional reference picture sets the style.
model.ui.description: Buttons, bars, slots and panels. An optional reference picture is the concept.
model.toPixelArt.description: Converts the reference picture at a quarter of its size.
model.toPixelArtProFlash.description: Picks the pixel size itself. The description is optional style guidance.
model.resize.description: Redraws the reference picture at twice its size, up to 200 pixels.
model.removeBackground.description: Up to 400×400. The description optionally names the subject.
model.normalMap.description: A normal map of the reference picture, for lighting in a game engine.
model.edit.description: Describe the change to the reference picture.
model.editPro.description: Describe the change to the reference picture.
model.editProFlash.description: Describe the change. The reference picture must be at least 32×32.
model.character4.description: 64×64, or the size of an optional south-facing reference picture.
model.character8.description: 64×64, or the size of an optional south-facing reference picture.
model.characterPro.description: Eight directions. An optional reference picture sets the style.
model.characterProFlash.description: Eight directions. An optional reference picture is the south view.
model.characterState.description: Describe a new outfit, pose or change for the reference character.
model.pixminimaxAnimation.description: Eight frames. Needs a PixelLab Tier 1 plan or higher.
model.animationPro.description: The reference picture must be at least 32×32.
model.interpolation.description: Connect the start picture first, then the end picture. Describe the change.
model.rotate.description: Turns a south-facing reference picture to the direction named in the description, such as west; east when none is named.
model.rotations8.description: Turns a south-facing reference picture to all eight directions.
model.rotations8Pro.description: Rotates a reference picture, or creates a new subject from the description.
model.object.description: 64×64. An optional reference picture sets the style.
model.objectPro.description: 64×64. Shows the first of PixelLab's candidates.
model.object8.description: An optional reference picture is turned to eight directions.
model.objectAnimation.description: Describe how the object in the reference picture moves.
model.tileset.description: 32px tiles. Describe it as lower terrain | upper terrain, with an optional | transition.
model.tilesetSidescroller.description: 32px tiles. Describe the platform, optionally followed by | its surface.
model.tilesPro.description: 32px top-down tiles. Shows the first variation.
model.vfx.description: An animated effect. An optional reference picture is the sprite it plays around.
